verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਮ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਹੁਇ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹਾਰਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham sam dhekh samadharasee hui akath kathaa beechaar haar mon dhaaree hai ||

en.bdb: A pursuant disciple of the True Guru feels the presence of Lord Almighty in every living being and at all places, becomes impartial and instead of indulging in discussions of Lord's visible plays and performances, remains engrossed in Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਨਹਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: honahaar hoi taa(n) te aasaa te niraas bhe kaaran karan prabh jaan haumai maaree hai ||

en.bdb: Whatever is happening, is happening in His will. Thus such a disciple remains unsullied of all his desire. Knowing the traits of the Almighty who is the cause and effect of everything, he loses his pride and ego in accordance with immortal saying of Gurbani ''Main nahi Prabh sabh(u) kichh(u) tera"

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੁਇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਏ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sookham sathool oa(n)kaar kai akaar hui braham bibek budh bhe brahamachaaree hai ||

en.bdb: He accepts that all big or small forms have come out of One Lord. Adopting the divine wisdom, he becomes Godly in character.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਟ ਬੀਜ ਕੋ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਛਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੪੫੮॥
verses.translit_en: baT beej ko bithaar braham kai maiaa chhaiaa gurmukh ek Tek dhubidhaa nivaaree hai ||458||

en.bdb: Just as a well-spread banyan tree is born out of a seed, his form also spreads around in the form of maya. An obedient Sikh of the Guru removes his duality by leaning heavily on this support without being enamored by any other gods/godesses. (458)
